race.comment: FOVEA (9) is lightly raced and progressive, having won her Maiden by two and a half lengths at Kembla Grange before a sound second in BM68 grade at Warwick Farm. Cross over nose band goes on and has the speed to et across. ASCOT GREEN (2) resumes after a six-month break with two trials behind her, including a latest third at Kembla Grange, and she has won her only previous try around 1100m. Her autumn form included a Class 1 win at Kembla Grange before contesting Saturday company at Randwick. Looms as a serious threat fresh. PREMIUM (1) looks well placed third-up after a second and a fifth at Illawarra Grange, and her record around 1100m, at this venue and on wet ground gives her the most rounded profile. The 2kg claim helps offset the top weight, and she has enough race fitness to peak now. HEY JUDE (11) was well beaten last start, after striking early interference. Fitter third-up and her previous third at Kembla Grange keeps her in the winning conversation.
